speaker: Doctor
text: Can you tell me if your double vision improves when you close one eye, and do you experience any drooping of your eyelids? Also, how long have you been experiencing these symptoms?

speaker: Patient
text: The double vision usually happens when I look up or down, and the weakness in my arms and legs gets worse after activity but improves if I rest. I have not noticed balance problems or numbness.

speaker: Doctor
text: That pattern of worsening with activity and improving with rest is very specific; have you noticed any difficulty with swallowing or speaking? REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count_with_Electrolytes_and_Creatine_Kinase.

speaker: Doctor
text: Since your CBC and CK are normal, have you noticed any recent infections like a cold or flu, and do you experience difficulty chewing or managing your saliva? REQUEST TEST: Antibody_Painful_Fatigue_Syndrome.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Since your antibody panel for Myasthenia Gravis is negative, have you noticed any ptosis (drooping eyelids) or difficulty swallowing that worsens later in the day? Also, has anyone observed your double vision shifting direction or disappearing when you cover one eye?

REQUEST TEST: Antinuclear_Antibody (ANA)

speaker: Doctor
text: Since your ANA is normal and you have no sensory deficits, do you experience specific trouble rising from a squatting position, and does your double vision worsen significantly when you look upwards or downwards?

speaker: Patient
text: I have not had recent infections or fevers, and there is no family history of neurological disease. The weakness feels symmetrical in both arms and legs.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the fluctuating weakness worsening with activity and sparing sensation, do you experience significant difficulty lifting your head against gravity or holding your arms outstretched for a few seconds? REQUEST TEST: Acetylcholine_Receptor_Antibody_and_Muscle_Specific_Kinase_Antibody.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Multiple Sclerosis (likely presenting with brainstem involvement causing diplopia and pyramidal weakness).
